paragraphs.en: 总结：MOSS-Image开源文生图系统通过5B扩散Transformer与意图感知提示增强模块，实现高保真双语长文本渲染与精准排版控制，并发布评测基准。 Recent closed-source image generation systems can produce diverse visual content from simple compositions to information-dense graphics, yet open-weight text-to-image models still struggle with dense text and intricate layouts. To narrow this gap, we introduce MOSS-Image, an open generation system that combines high-fidelity visual synthesis with intent-aware composition. First, we pretrain a 5B single-stream diffusion transformer (DiT) from scratch with a carefully designed recipe, enabling bilingual long-form text rendering and precise layout control. Second, we develop an intention-aware agentic prompt enhancement (PE) module that translates diverse user requests into detailed content and layout specifications. Together, they enable MOSS-Image to generate text-rich and layout-coherent images. We further introduce LongLongTextBench (LLTB) for evaluating long-form English and Chinese text rendering, and RealLayoutArena (RLA) for end-to-end layout-rich generation. MOSS-Image achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-weight models on LLTB, with an average text coverage of 96.3%. On RLA, MOSS-Image ranks second in the end-to-end system comparison, while its backbone ranks first among generators evaluated with shared enhanced prompts. We will release the model, training recipe, and evaluation framework to support further research and promote the text-to-image community.
paragraphs.zh: 总结：MOSS-Image开源文生图系统通过5B扩散Transformer与意图感知提示增强模块，实现高保真双语长文本渲染与精准排版控制，并发布评测基准。近期闭源图像生成系统能够生成从简单构图到信息密集图形的多样化视觉内容，然而开放权重的文生图模型在密集文本与复杂排版方面仍表现不佳。 为缩小这一差距，我们推出了MOSS-Image，这是一个将高保真视觉合成与意图感知构图相结合的开源生成系统。 首先，我们采用精心设计的方案从零预训练一个5B单流扩散Transformer（DiT），使其具备双语长文本渲染与精准排版控制能力。 其次，我们开发了意图感知的智能体化提示增强（PE）模块，将多样的用户请求转化为详细的内容与排版规范。 二者结合，使MOSS-Image能够生成文本丰富且排版连贯的图像。 我们进一步推出LongLongTextBench（LLTB）用于评测长篇英文与中文文本渲染，并推出RealLayoutArena（RLA）用于端到端的富排版生成。 在开放权重模型中，MOSS-Image在LLTB上取得了最先进的性能，平均文本覆盖率达到96.3%。 在RLA的端到端系统对比中，MOSS-Image排名第二，而在使用共享增强提示评估的生成器中，其主干模型排名第一。 我们将发布模型、训练方案与评测框架，以支持进一步研究并推动文生图社区的发展。
